info.name: DeawKoyKid Backend - Sprint 1
info.description:
Sprint 1 API acceptance collection, reviewed 2026-09-13.

Run ALL folders in order against a development/test database. The base URL defaults to http://localhost:8080 (Backend/.env and frontend OpenAPI); override baseUrl if needed. Setup creates unique synthetic accounts every iteration. Keep variable values if you want to rerun individual requests. Created IDs are recorded in createdUserIds; there is no delete-user API, so test records remain.

[ SPEC GAP ] requests in folder 07 are active tests that expect the required 400 rejection. The current backend lacks these validations, so failures are expected and must not be weakened into successes.

Most requests disable the automatic cookie jar and use explicitly captured account cookies. Folder 08 enables the real cookie jar to verify login → profile → logout → 401. Folder 09 explicitly skips until a previously accepted token has naturally expired.

Coverage limits: UI validation, password confirmation, policy modal/content, cookie banner/180-day localStorage, client-side logout state, Figma/team reviews, bcrypt storage and consentAt persistence cannot be established by these HTTP responses alone. Verify DB fields separately. ID-card file upload has no endpoint/field contract yet, so no upload request is invented.

See DeawKoyKid-Sprint1.postman_README.md for the task map, expected gaps, rerun instructions and validation results.
